questions.q: What does the word "Rom" mean in the Romani language?
questions.e: In the video: "Rom na ciganskom znači čovek" — Rom in Romani means a person.

questions.q: Which word, according to the speaker, must be used in official speech?
questions.e: In the video: "u zvaničnom jeziku mora se koristiti reč koja pripada nama... to je Rom" — in official language the word that belongs to us must be used... that is Rom.

questions.q: Which book by Mika Antić changed the author's path?
questions.e: In the video: "do mene je slučajno došla zbirka pesama „Garavi sokak“ od Mike Antića, i ja sam posle pet pesama rekao: to je to" — a poetry collection "Garavi sokak" by Mika Antić came into my hands by chance, and after five poems I said: that's it.

questions.q: How old was the author when he met Mika?
questions.e: In the video: "Ja sam bio vrlo mlad, 18 godina, kad sam upoznao Miku" — I was very young, 18 years old, when I met Mika.

questions.q: Who was Mile Dileja?
o: A school friend of Mika's father, a talented boy with a vivid imagination
questions.e: In the video: "Mile Dileja zaista postoji. On je bio tatin školski drug... pun mašte" — Mile Dileja really exists. He was Dad's school friend... full of imagination.

questions.q: What did Žarko Jovanović, known as Jagdino, come up with?
o: The Roma flag — blue sky, green grass and a wheel
questions.e: In the video: "izmislio onu zastavu njihovu: plavo nebo, zelena trava i točak u sredini" — he invented their flag: blue sky, green grass and a wheel in the middle.

questions.q: What are the Roma afraid of, according to the narrator?
o: Evil spirits (čohani), water and people in uniform
questions.e: In the video: "strah od vode... strah od uniformisanih lica... ali najveći strah je strah od čohana" — fear of water... fear of uniformed persons... but the greatest fear is the fear of čohani.

questions.q: How does the narrator describe Romani music?
o: Sad and cheerful at the same time, about life, love and death
questions.e: In the video: "Život, ljubav, smrt... muziku koja je vrlo tužna, vrlo osećajna i vrlo vesela" — life, love, death... music that is very sad, very emotional and very cheerful.

sections.title: Vocabulary
sections.about: Words from the video and their translations

questions.q: Reč se koristi u pežorativnom, odnosno *pogrdnom* kontekstu.
questions.e: Pogrdan — offensive, derogatory.

questions.q: Do mene je slučajno došla *zbirka* pesama.
questions.e: Zbirka — a collection, an anthology.

questions.q: Zanat se može naučiti, ali *mašta* ne.
questions.e: Mašta — imagination, fantasy.

questions.q: Izmislio je i onu *zastavu*.
questions.e: Zastava — a flag.

questions.q: Napravio je romski *rečnik*.
questions.e: Rečnik — a dictionary; reč — a word.

questions.q: Taj talentovani dečak je bio *streljan*.
questions.e: Streljati — to shoot; streljan — shot (executed).

questions.q: Oni su umeli da nam poruče tu *dragocenu* filozofiju.
questions.e: Dragocen — precious, valuable.

questions.q: Čohano, to znači *strašilo*, vampir.
questions.e: Strašilo — a scarecrow; strah — fear.

questions.q: U koje spadate i vi koji ste ovde sa ___.
questions.e: Sa ("with") requires the instrumental case: ja → sa mnom.

questions.q: Po svom načinu života i po ___.
questions.e: Po requires the dative/locative case: po tradiciji.

questions.q: ja onda ___ to što njih na neki način pogađa,
questions.e: "Then" marks a next moment, so perfective: osetim. Osećam is imperfective (a continuing state).

questions.q: i grad Pariz ___ je omogućio
questions.e: Omogućiti kome? Dative: on → mu ("to him").

questions.q: Upoznali su se sa mojim ___ i njegovom suprugom.
questions.e: Sa ("with") requires the instrumental case: sa ocem.

questions.q: U tim, kobajagi ___, pesmama
questions.e: The adjective agrees with the noun: u tim pesmama is locative plural, so dečjim.

questions.q: Romi imaju kolektivni strah od ___.
questions.e: Strah od ("fear of") requires the genitive case: od vode.

questions.q: Kada smo veseli, kada smo ___, tu su instrumenti.
questions.e: The adjective agrees with the subject "we" in the masculine plural: tužni.
